title: Full Stack Engineer
text:
Tandem Notes is a collaborative workspace for research teams. We're a 25-person company looking for a Full Stack Engineer who enjoys shipping end to end.

You will
- Build product features across a React and TypeScript front end (Next.js) and a Node.js back end.
- Design GraphQL and REST APIs backed by PostgreSQL and Redis.
- Implement real-time collaboration features over WebSockets.
- Write tests with Jest and Playwright; keep our GitHub Actions CI green.
- Care about accessibility and responsive design; work closely with design in Figma.
- Deploy on Vercel and AWS; use Docker for local environments.

You have
- 2+ years of professional full-stack experience.
- Strong JavaScript and TypeScript, HTML and CSS (Tailwind CSS is what we use).
- Comfort with SQL and data modeling.
- Bonus: experience with Stripe billing or Sentry.

Salary range $140k-$175k plus equity. Hybrid in New York, 2 days a week.
